prompt: In which year did California experience its second instance of wildfires burning more than 2 million acres, destroying scores of homes and other buildings?
answer: California’s second year with more than 2 million acres burned was **2021**, when approximately **2.6 million acres** burned and wildfires destroyed or damaged numerous homes and other structures.
